_comment: Per-language pronunciation overrides, applied to whole words after name substitution and text cleaning. Value = plain respelling (fed to the normal G2P) or /phonemes/ in Kokoro's phoneme alphabet (inserted verbatim). Urdu name tokens ({f:id}/{n:id}) are additionally pronounced from the parallel Devanagari name in hi.json unless overridden here (see 'ur_names_from_hindi' in generate_voice.py).
